articles.headline: Factory raises $200 million as enterprise AI agents gain traction in engineering
articles.summary: Factory’s large funding round signals strong investor appetite for AI agents that automate enterprise engineering work. For business leaders, this points to rising pressure to improve productivity, but also to reassess software budgets, governance, and cybersecurity controls around autonomous tools.

articles.headline: EU Cyber Resilience Act reporting obligations went live, forcing faster vulnerability disclosure
articles.summary: The EU’s new 24-hour vulnerability reporting rules materially raise compliance pressure for any company selling connected products into Europe, including legacy devices already in market. This increases legal, operational, and security-response demands, with substantial penalties for non-compliance.
articles.source: AI in Cybersecurity: Today's Top Stories

articles.headline: Empresas deben prepararse para nuevas obligaciones del Cyber Resilience Act
articles.summary: Las nuevas reglas elevan el listón de cumplimiento para productos y servicios digitales, con impacto directo en proveedores de software, hardware y dispositivos conectados. Para negocios medianos y pequeños, esto puede traducirse en más exigencias de seguridad, documentación y selección de proveedores.
